title: 第二十五 章 焚元破境丹第二十六 章 兽潮
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
“哼！该死的人类，竟敢擅闯本王领地，还想全身而退，简直做梦！”
金雕怒声咆哮，携带着令人胆寒的威压，瞬间席卷开来。
一众炼气修士仿佛被一座无形的大山狠狠压下，顿时喘不过气，纷纷无力地趴在地上。
即便是四名筑基修士，也被这股磅礴威压震得双腿不受控制地剧烈颤抖。
所有人眼中，都写满了深深的绝望。
几个呼吸间，金雕那庞大的身影便出现在众人眼前。
当它瞧见苍鹰所在之处只剩一滩鲜血时，金雕结丹后期的恐怖气息瞬间毫爆发开来。
它眼中血丝密布，发出一声愤怒到极点的咆哮，如实质般的杀气弥漫四周，死死地盯着在场每一个人。
那些炼气修士，直接被这股强大威压碾压成血雾。
夏临渊几人也被震得口吐鲜血，眼中满是无尽的恐惧。
“你们都得死……”
金雕尖啸着，扑向离它最近的李明远，锋利的爪子瞬间将其头颅抓碎。
李明山见状，吓得魂飞魄散，脸色惨白。
他连忙操控着所有噬灵蜂，不顾一切的攻向金雕王，自己则转身朝着洞穴通道拼命逃去。
金雕瞧也不瞧一眼，只是随意挥动那金色的翅膀，一阵劲风呼啸而过，只听一阵清脆的骨骼碎裂声传来，逃跑中的李明山便应声倒地。
那些挡在金雕面前的数万噬灵蜂，如同雨点般纷纷坠落，砸向地面。
要知道，人类饲养的妖兽林檎，一旦与主人签订契约，主人若是死亡，它们也会随之殒命。
夏临渊和夏玄洲望着金雕这恐怖绝伦的战力，额头上冷汗直冒，眼皮不受控制的狂跳。
夏临渊急忙传音给夏玄洲，说道：“玄洲，你把储物袋拿好，我来为你争取几息的逃跑时间！”
言罢，夏临渊迅速将一个储物袋塞到夏玄洲手中。

紧接着毫不犹豫的掏出一枚漆黑的丹药，一口吞入腹中。
丹药入口即化，一滴滚烫的药液如汹涌的洪流，径直冲向丹田，随后猛地炸开！
夏临渊的瞳孔瞬间变得鲜红如血，周身灵力如火山喷发般急剧暴涨。
只听见“咔嚓”一声。
他筑基圆满的壁垒直接破碎，汹涌的灵力让他的修为直冲结丹境。
夏临渊吞噬的是一种极为特殊的丹药，名为焚元破境丹，此丹以燃烧自身精元为代价，强行提升修为。
然而，使用这种丹药，只能维持不到五息的时间，随后修为便会急剧跌落，并且会力竭而亡，因此鲜有人敢轻易尝试。
“我拦住它，你快走！”夏临渊声嘶力竭的怒吼道。
夏玄洲没有丝毫犹豫，转身朝着甬道全力飞奔而去。
“哼！想走？没那么容易！”
金雕眼中闪过一丝狠厉，锐利的爪尖带着破风的呼啸，如闪电般抓向夏玄洲。
夏临渊岂会让它得逞。
只见他紧握长剑，将全身灵力疯狂灌注剑身，长剑瞬间变得通红，发出一阵嗡嗡的鸣叫。
“青光剑影，绞杀！”
夏临渊大喝一声，踏前一步，右手用力一挥，数百道红色剑光横扫而出，与金雕的利爪悍然相撞。
强大的冲击力让夏临渊止不住的往后退了好几步，一口鲜血不受控制的从嘴角溢出。
尽管夏临渊奋力挡住了金雕的攻击，但身后的夏玄洲还是被金雕攻击所携带的破风击中。
content_en:
"Hmph! Damn humans, how dare you trespass into my king's territory and want to escape unscathed, it's just a dream!"
The golden eagle roared angrily, carrying a chilling coercion and sweeping away in an instant.
The group of Qi Refining cultivators seemed to be pressed down hard by an invisible mountain. They were suddenly out of breath and lay weakly on the ground.
Even the four foundation-building monks were shaken by this majestic pressure, causing their legs to tremble uncontrollably.
Everyone's eyes were filled with deep despair.
In a few breaths, the huge figure of the golden eagle appeared in front of everyone.
When it saw that there was only a pool of blood where the goshawk was, the terrifying aura in the late stage of the Golden Eagle's pill formation instantly erupted.
Its eyes were bloodshot, and it let out an extremely angry roar. Substantial murderous intent filled the surroundings, staring at everyone present.
Those Qi Refining monks were directly crushed into blood mist by this powerful pressure.
Xia Linyuan and others were also shocked to the point of vomiting blood, and their eyes were full of endless fear.
"You all must die..."
The golden eagle screamed and pounced on Li Mingyuan, who was closest to it, and its sharp claws instantly scratched his head into pieces.
When Li Mingshan saw this, he was so frightened that his face turned pale.
He quickly controlled all the Soul Devouring Bees and attacked the Golden Eagle King desperately, while he turned around and fled towards the cave passage.
The golden eagle didn't even look at it, and just waved its golden wings casually. A strong wind roared past, and there was only a crisp sound of bones breaking, and Li Mingshan fell to the ground while running away.
The tens of thousands of Soul Devouring Bees that stood in front of the golden eagle fell like raindrops and hit the ground.
You know, once the demonic beasts raised by humans, Ringo, sign a contract with their master, if the master dies, they will also die.
Xia Linyuan and Xia Xuanzhou looked at the terrifying fighting power of the golden eagle, cold sweat broke out on their foreheads, and their eyelids twitched uncontrollably.
Xia Linyuan hurriedly sent a message to Xia Xuanzhou and said, "Xuanzhou, take your storage bag and I'll buy you a few breaths of time to escape!"
After saying that, Xia Linyuan quickly stuffed a storage bag into Xia Xuanzhou's hands.
Then he took out a dark pill without hesitation and swallowed it in one gulp.
The elixir melts immediately in the mouth, and a drop of hot liquid rushes straight to the Dantian like a raging torrent, and then explodes violently!
Xia Linyuan's pupils instantly turned as red as blood, and his spiritual power surged like a volcano erupting.
Only a "click" was heard.
The barrier of his perfect foundation was shattered directly, and the surging spiritual power made his cultivation reach the realm of pill formation.
What Xia Linyuan swallowed was a very special elixir called the Burning Yuan Breaking Pill. This elixir forcibly improved his cultivation at the cost of burning his own essence.
However, using this kind of elixir can only last for less than five breaths, and then your cultivation level will drop sharply and you will die of exhaustion, so few people dare to try it easily.
"I'll stop it, hurry up!" Xia Linyuan roared at the top of his lungs.
Xia Xuanzhou didn't hesitate at all, turned around and ran towards the corridor with all his strength.
"Hmph! Want to leave? It's not that easy!"
A trace of fierceness flashed in the golden eagle's eyes, and the sharp claw tips, with the whistling of the wind, grabbed Xia Xuanzhou like lightning.
How could Xia Linyuan let it succeed?
He was seen holding the sword tightly, pouring all his spiritual energy into the sword. The sword instantly turned red and made a buzzing sound.
"Azure light sword shadow, strangle!"
Xia Linyuan shouted loudly, took a step forward, waved his right hand vigorously, hundreds of red sword lights swept out, and collided with the sharp claws of the golden eagle.
The powerful impact made Xia Linyuan take several steps back uncontrollably, and a mouthful of blood flowed out of the corner of his mouth uncontrollably.
Although Xia Linyuan tried his best to block the golden eagle's attack, Xia Xuanzhou behind him was still hit by the breaking wind carried by the golden eagle's attack.
